data.why: The interface reads its four example Excel datasets straight from the repo's own inputs/ (no upload widget exists); the two seeded source files replace the live Nominatim geocoder and PVGIS/Geoapify network calls with deterministic offline equivalents so the install step can pre-build data/*.csv and cache_pv_profile.json without outbound access.

goals: Configure a disposition scenario (cost scenario, year, V2G, external charging, day) in the sidebar and trigger the MIQCP solve for that day
Inspect the four derived input datasets (routed trips, cost parameters, depot load/PV, charging stations) before running
Review the resulting schedule, driver roster, state-of-charge/charging-power and depot-power figures, and download the schedule CSV
Run Auto-Sizing over a date range to size a fleet (how many ICE vs BEV trucks to buy) and inspect the charger-sizing table
Run a parameter sweep across scenario/year/V2G/external-charging combinations and download the summary CSV
Toggle V2G and external-charging settings and compare energy cost and driver counts across two runs

review.summary: The tree follows the interface's own order (inputs, settings, run, results), labels are clean, and every screen I opened shows what its node claims; it is honest that the Gurobi licence blocked every new solve. It needs fixes before filing: one task turns a fake-geocoding artifact into a workflow branch, the sizing and sweep results and the crewed-vs-autonomous comparison are missing, and the result-viewer feature should be split.
